_meta.title: Singapore property decision — regulatory & loan-engine constants
_meta.not_advice: Educational illustration of published rules, not financial or mortgage advice. Verify against MAS / MoneySense / IRAS / HDB before acting.
_meta.stability_note: Buyer-side parameters (TDSR, MSR, LTV, BSD, ABSD) unchanged since 27 Apr 2023 (ABSD/BSD) and 20 Aug 2024 (HDB LTV). Seller-side is NOT static: SSD holding period extended 3y->4y with rates raised 4pp on 4 Jul 2025 (encoded below); EC-specific tightening 8 May 2026 (see market.json ec_policy_2026). Owner-occupier property-tax schedule (bands from 1 Jan 2025) added 2 Sep 2026; curated rates refreshed the same day. Statutory leasehold relativity table (SLA, Bala's Table) added 5 Sep 2026 for the own-vs-rent lease run-down line.
_meta.sources: MAS; MoneySense (retrieved Jul 2026); IRAS / MOF (15 Feb 2023 stamp-duty revision; property-tax bands from 1 Jan 2025); HDB / MND (20 Aug 2024); SLA leasehold relativity table via Kwong, Goh and Ti (SMU, 2025) and Kwek and Hoh (CLC, 2017).

tdsr.note: Total monthly debt obligations must not exceed 55% of gross monthly income. The property instalment in the test is computed at the higher of the 4.0% p.a. medium-term floor or the actual rate. Binding constraint for most private-property buyers.
tdsr.source: MAS (medium-term rate effective 30 Sep 2022; 55% TDSR since 16 Dec 2021)

msr.note: Mortgage Servicing Ratio: housing loan instalment must not exceed 30% of gross monthly income. Applies ON TOP of TDSR for HDB and new ECs; does not apply to private condos or resale ECs past MOP.

ltv.note: Loan-to-value ceilings for bank loans to individuals. The MAX tier applies only if BOTH: loan tenure within the cliff AND borrower age + tenure <= 65 at the end of the loan. Otherwise the REDUCED tier applies and the minimum cash portion rises.

reduction_trigger.note: If tenure exceeds 30y (private) / 25y (HDB) OR the loan runs past age 65, LTV steps down to the reduced tier and first-loan minimum cash rises from 5% to 10%.

hdb_concessionary.note: HDB loan LTV cut 80%->75% on 20 Aug 2024. Downpayment can be fully CPF (no minimum cash). Tenure capped at the shorter of 25y and age 65. Eligible loan sized at a 3% floor (introduced 30 Sep 2022). Household income ceiling S$14,000 (S$7,000 singles).
hdb_concessionary.source: HDB/MND (20 Aug 2024); MAS/MND/HDB joint release (29 Sep 2022); HDB HLE

tenure_cap_years.note: Absolute maximum loan tenures. Separate from the LTV cliff at 30y/25y/age-65 above. For a borrower of age A wanting full 75% LTV on a private purchase, usable tenure = min(30, 65 - A). An EC bought from a developer follows the private 35y cap: Notice 632 para 22 applies the 30y cap to 'HDB Flat' as defined via the Housing and Development Act, and para 8(a)(i) lists ECs separately from HDB Flats - so ECs fall under the para 21 general 35y cap.
tenure_cap_years.flag: Many banks nonetheless cap EC tenure at 30y in practice; beyond 30y the reduced LTV tier applies in any case.
tenure_cap_years.source: MAS Notice 632 (last revised 21 Aug 2025), paras 8(a)(i), 21, 22 and the HDB Flat definition; MAS/MoneySense explainers (Jul 2026)

absd.note: Additional Buyer's Stamp Duty, on the higher of price or market value. Index = [1st property, 2nd, 3rd or more]. US nationals, and nationals/PRs of Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland, are treated as Singapore Citizens under FTAs. Unchanged since 27 Apr 2023.

bsd.note: Buyer's Stamp Duty, residential, effective 15 Feb 2023, on the higher of price or market value. Marginal tiers.

ssd.note: Seller's Stamp Duty, residential: payable if the property is sold within 4 years of purchase, on the higher of price or market value, by year of sale (year 1 = 16%). Applies to purchases on/after 4 Jul 2025; earlier purchases keep the prior 3-year 12/8/4% schedule. HDB's 5-year MOP normally outlasts it.
ssd.source: MAS/MOF/MND joint release 3 Jul 2025; IRAS SSD (residential)

property_tax.note: Owner-occupier residential property tax: progressive marginal rates on the Annual Value (AV), which IRAS sets from the market rent of comparable properties. The page proxies AV with gross yield x price (flagged as a proxy; prime rents yield less, so the tax there runs lower than the proxy). Non-owner-occupier rates (12-36%) are not modelled - the tool is for a home you live in. The 2026 one-off 15% rebate for owner-occupied HDB flats is not modelled.
property_tax.source: IRAS property tax rates (owner-occupier, from 1 Jan 2025; Budget 2024 AV-band revision); gov.sg explainer 'Property tax on residential property' (retrieved 2 Sep 2026)

sora_3m.source: MAS-published 3M compounded SORA, via DollarBack Mortgage (2 Sep 2026: 1.1265%), cross-checked to PropertyNet (8 Aug 2026: 1.12%)
sora_3m.flag: published by MAS; retrieved via aggregators, not independently verified to the basis point

fixed_best.source: PropertyNet (8 Aug 2026: HSBC 2-yr fixed 1.40%); DollarBack (2 Sep 2026: Maybank 2-yr fixed 1.45%)
fixed_best.flag: broker-negotiated promo, not board rate; the two aggregators differ by 5bp

sora_history.cycle: near 0.2% in early 2022, above 3% by end-2022, around 3.5% through 2023-2024, then down to about 1% by mid-2026
sora_history.source: MAS-published 3M compounded SORA, via aggregators (moneylobang; MoneySmart), cross-checked to the curated spot
sora_history.flag: curated month-end readings, indicative to ~5bp; MAS publishes the authoritative daily series

rates.note: Live 3M SORA is scrapeable from the MAS domestic-interest-rates page; package rates have no public feed and are curated here. Refresh at each review.

cpf.note: CPF Ordinary Account pays 2.5% p.a. Cash used for downpayment/instalments has an opportunity cost at least equal to this (and typically the investor's portfolio return). Used in the cash-vs-mortgage module as the CPF hurdle.

age_decay.note: How much of a project's discount to its district is simply its age. Each resale's $psf against the median of its own (district, quarter, size band) cell — a cell pooling ALL building ages, own project excluded — grouped by building age at the transaction date. This is what the Projects table's 'vs area' column measures, so it is the right yardstick for reading that column.
age_decay.flag: National medians over wide age bands, NOT a per-project expectation. Not monotone: the 11-15 and 16-20 buckets are indistinguishable, partly because the top size band is open-ended above 1,150 sqft, so the zero crossing is placeable only to 15-20 years. The decay is the sum of lease run-down, physical depreciation and design obsolescence and this cannot separate them; it is cross-sectional, not one building followed through time; and en-bloc removes the old cohort's redevelopment candidates in an ambiguous direction.
age_decay.source: URA PMI_Resi_Transaction via scripts/study_launch_vs_resale.py::test_c_age_decay, pre-registered 2026-08-10, CI run 31360128362; reviews/2026-08-10_building-age-decay.md

lease_relativity.name: SLA leasehold relativity table (Bala's Table)
lease_relativity.unit: leasehold value as a percentage of freehold value, indexed by whole years of lease remaining: index 0 = expired = 0, index 99 = a fresh 99-year lease = 96.0
lease_relativity.anchors_note: The three alienation percentages documented from 1948 (Motha and Yuen 1999, via CLC 2017). The 30/60-year ratio 0.6/0.8 = 0.75 was the Victoria Street 2005 tender's own conversion factor between 30-year and 60-year bids. Both are pinned by scripts/test_engine_parity.js.
lease_relativity.statutory_basis: Seventh Schedule, Land Betterment Charge (Table of Rates and Valuation Method) Regulations 2022 (per Kwong, Goh and Ti 2025; the SSO text was not machine-readable on 5 Sep 2026). Published online by SLA from 31 Jul 2000; in use since about 1948.
lease_relativity.implied_discount_rate: about 3.5% (CLC 2017, present-value fit); 4.62% flat to year 38 easing to 3.81% at year 99, with freehold at 3.76% (Kwong, Goh and Ti 2025, IRR model 3)
lease_relativity.how_used: Statutory: scales the land betterment charge for sites with under 99 years left, and prices the tail of a lease on renewal (the premium is the gap between two table values: 70 -> 99 years is 96.0 - 86.0 = 10 points of freehold land value). HDB prices short-lease 2-room Flexi flats and Lease Buyback proceeds off the same ratios (within 0.011 across Green Spring 2019 and Towner Breeze 2024, per Kwong, Goh and Ti 2025).
lease_relativity.market_caveat: The private resale market has priced leasehold more steeply than this table at 60-85 years left. Giglio, Maggiori and Stroebel (NBER w20133; 1995-2013 Singapore sales, age and size controlled) find 71-85 years remaining trading 24% below freehold, against 7-14% here. The page therefore treats the table as the statutory FLOOR for lease run-down, not as a market forecast.
lease_relativity.note: Drives the lease run-down line in the own-vs-rent ledger: value lost over a holding period = 1 - pct(years left - years held) / pct(years left), applied to the price. A blank lease is freehold or unknown; anything above 200 years is treated as freehold-like, the Projects table's own tenure cut. Both charge nothing and the note says which.
lease_relativity.flag: A statutory schedule, not a market observation. All 99 entries verified identical across two public copies on 5 Sep 2026: the SMU paper's Table 1 (sourced to SLA) and the CLC 2017 Appendix 1.
lease_relativity.source: Singapore Land Authority, via Kwong, Goh and Ti, 'Unpacking Singapore's leasehold relativity table: an empirical and legal analysis', International Real Estate Review 28(3) 379-406 (2025), Table 1, open access at ink.library.smu.edu.sg/soe_research/2835; Kwek and Hoh, 'Determining the value of leasehold land: a closer look at Bala's Table', Centre for Liveable Cities (2017), Appendix 1
